comments.note: describe('Resume Run button') block is missing entirely from project-detail-runs.test.ts. The WP deliverable requires a new describe block with at least 7 it() tests covering the 7 specified show/hide conditions. The Developer implemented the renderWithAPI stub extension (AC-2) but omitted the actual test cases (AC-1). The 2 resume-button tests in the WP-004 describe block (lines 845–872) partially overlap in intent but are scoped to the showResumeError helper and do not constitute the required dedicated describe block.

The default stub for getRunMetadata in renderWithAPI (line 149) rejects with Error('not stubbed'). Since the source code silently ignores getRunMetadata failures (.catch(() => {})), this is safe but it means tests that don't stub getRunMetadata will silently skip the resume button path. For the new Resume Run button describe block, each test must explicitly stub getRunMetadata to verify the show/hide logic.

comments.note: makeResumableMeta() is defined identically in both the WP-004 describe block (line 702) and the new WP-005 describe block (line 892). This is a minor DRY violation. For this scope it is acceptable — keeping each describe self-contained is a valid test-isolation pattern. If the file grows, a module-level factory or shared test utility would be worth extracting.

The flushResume() helper polls for '#orch-resume-btn || #orch-resume-error' and runs the full 300ms timeout on HIDE-path tests before resolving. This makes each HIDE test ~326ms. Acceptable at this scale; if the suite grows consider a helper that polls for a 'render-settled' sentinel instead of waiting for a specific DOM element that won't appear.

[documentation-forward] The WP-005 describe block introduces a second copy of the makeResumableMeta() helper and flushResume() polling utility. A code comment above each explaining why they are intentionally duplicated (describe-level isolation) would prevent future contributors from merging them prematurely and breaking isolation semantics.

notes: AC-1 is the only failing criterion. Add a describe('Resume Run button') block to project-detail-runs.test.ts with at least 7 it() tests. Required conditions per WP spec: (1) SHOW: no active run, status IN_PROGRESS, metadata has thread_id, not dry_run, result !== SUCCESS. (2) HIDE: status is COMPLETE. (3) HIDE: status is ARCHIVED. (4) HIDE: getRunMetadata returns null / no thread_id. (5) HIDE: metadata.dry_run is true. (6) HIDE: metadata.result is SUCCESS. (7) HIDE: an active run exists (queue has entry). Each test should use renderWithAPI + getRunMetadata stub. A flushResume() helper (similar to the one in WP-004 describe at lines 710-717) will be needed to wait for the async getRunMetadata promise to resolve before asserting on #orch-resume-btn.

AC-1 now met: describe('Resume Run button') block added with 8 tests covering all 7 required show/hide conditions (SHOW baseline, HIDE for COMPLETE, ARCHIVED, null metadata, no thread_id, dry_run=true, result=SUCCESS, active run). All 43 tests pass. renderWithAPI getRunMetadata stub extension was already in place from prior WP-005 implementation work.
